**For Topic**:

[block:code]
{
  "codes": [
    {
      "code": "{\n\n\"code\": 69,\n\n\"description\": \"Topics based messaging feature is not available for your tenant\"\n\n}",
      "language": "json"
    }
  ]
}
[/block]

[block:callout]
{

}
[/block]
